observations: Orange gas cylinder with a black mesh protective sleeve.
Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON) logo is visible on the cylinder body in photo 0.
Text 'NICE FORTUNES NIG LTD' and 'ROYAL' are printed on the cylinder in photo 0.
The valve is a standard camping-style internal thread connection, shown in photo 1.
Watermarks 'SPARKLES WAYS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appear on all images.
A camera watermark in the bottom left of all photos reads 'REDMI 15C'.
A date stamp in the bottom right of all photos reads '12/10/2026'.

claims.evidence: There is no physical indicator of the duration of ownership or use.
The exterior paint appears fresh and the valve assembly shows no signs of heavy corrosion or damage in photo 1.

risks.proof: A photo of the item next to a current physical newspaper or a live video call.
A photo of the weight specifications stamped on the handle or foot ring.
A clear photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamp on the shroud.
A video showing a soapy water test on the valve while under pressure.

proof_requests: Photo of the cylinder with a handwritten note showing today's date to verify the image is not faked.
Close-up photo of the stamped markings on the handle to confirm capacity and expiry date.
Video of the valve being tested with soapy water.
response.reason: The photos contain a camera watermark for a 'REDMI 15C' and a date in the year 2026. As the Redmi 15C model does not currently exist and the date is in the future, the images are likely manipulated or generated by a scamming tool.
